description: Convert a public Google Form, Typeform, or Tally form into a new Clipform. Supported URLs: Google Forms (docs.google.com or forms.gle - must be shared as "Anyone with the link"), Typeform (form.typeform.com/to/...), and Tally (tally.so - must be public). The source form must be publicly accessible; a private form's questions cannot be read. The new Clipform is created as a DRAFT - review it, then republish with clipform_update_form (is_live: true) once it's ready. Some question types don't map cleanly to a Clipform node and are skipped rather than guessed at; the result always reports exactly what was imported vs skipped, and why.

context.description: Describe the user's underlying goal in one sentence - not the tool you're calling.

url.description: Public URL of the Google Form, Typeform, or Tally form to import

workspace_id.description: Workspace to act in (id from clipform_whoami workspaces). Omit to use the connection's default workspace.

name: clipform_import_form

form_id.description: New form's UUID - pass to follow-up tools. Null when no importable questions were found (nothing was created).

imported.description: Questions successfully converted into Clipform nodes

skipped.description: Questions that could not be converted

skipped_details.description: Per-skipped-question title, reason, and source question type

total_questions.description: Total questions found in the source form

warnings.description: Non-fatal issues surfaced during the import

viewer_url.description: The address this form WILL be live at once published (clipform_update_form with is_live: true) - it is a draft and is NOT viewable by anyone yet; opening it now shows a maintenance screen, not the form. Null when no importable questions were found.

workspace_name.description: Name of the workspace the form was created in

title: Import Form
